as_told.title: Randy Anderson sees triangle craft at Area 51

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions a man named Randy Anderson. Michels says Anderson claimed he saw triangle-shaped craft taking off from Area 51, a secretive US military test site in the Nevada desert. Michels brings this up with his guest, a researcher who goes by the name UAPGerb and who first made Anderson's account public, because if true it would mean unknown craft were flying out of one of America's most secret bases.
